record.paper_title: Open problems in local discrete holomorphic dynamics
record.context_brief: Formal classification with only degenerate directions
record.original_question: Find formal normal forms and complete formal invariants for germs tangent to the identity whose characteristic directions are all degenerate. This asks for the missing part of the formal classification beyond the case where at least one non-degenerate characteristic direction is present.

evidence.quote: (OP15) Find formal normal forms and invariants for germs tangent to the identity having only degenerate characteristic directions.

u(v)=\lambda v$ for some $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}$. The direction $[v]$ is called non-degenerate if $\lambda

u(v)=0$).

Two formal germs tangent to the identity are formally conjugate if there exists a formal invertible change of coordinates $\varphi(z)=z+O(|z|^2)\in\mathbb{C}[[z_1,\dots,z_n]]^n$ such that $\varphi^{-1}\circ f\circ\varphi=g$ as formal power series.

Problem. Restrict attention to the class $\mathcal{D}_n$ of formal germs $f$ tangent to the identity at $0\in\mathbb{C}^n$ ($n\ge 2$) for which every characteristic direction is degenerate (i.e., $P_
u(v)\parallel v$ implies $P_
u(v)=0$). Produce:

(a) an explicit list of formal normal forms for $\mathcal{D}_n$ under formal conjugacy, i.e., a family of distinguished representatives such that every $f\in\mathcal{D}_n$ is formally conjugate to exactly one (or to one in a controlled finite set) member of the family;

(b) a complete set of formal invariants distinguishing the formal conjugacy classes inside $\mathcal{D}_n$.

Solve the analogous classification question that, in the presence of at least one non-degenerate characteristic direction, is handled by classical Poincaré–Dulac type normal forms.
artifact.category_tag: Local holomorphic dynamics: tangent to identity germs
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g., Mongodi 2021/2023 on birational properties of tangent-to-identity germs without non-degenerate singular directions, and several papers on degenerate characteristic directions in dimensions 2 and 3) studies geometric and dynamical aspects of the purely degenerate case, but no complete formal classification (normal forms together with a full set of formal invariants) for germs whose characteristic directions are all degenerate appears in the literature. The problem appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Birational properties of tangent to the identity germs without non-degenerate singular directions
status_evidence.snippet: Studies tangent-to-identity germs in C^3 admitting only degenerate characteristic directions, identifying new classes (degenerate spikes, spinning/half corners) but not providing a complete formal classification.
status_evidence.claim: The purely degenerate case is investigated geometrically; classification of formal normal forms/invariants is not given.

status_evidence.title: Degenerate characteristic directions for maps tangent to the Identity
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates dynamics at degenerate characteristic directions; partial results, no complete formal normal form.
status_evidence.claim: Partial dynamical results exist for degenerate characteristic directions.

status_evidence.title: Formal Poincaré-Dulac renormalization for holomorphic germs
status_evidence.snippet: Provides formal normal forms simpler than classical Poincaré–Dulac, with second-order resonance phenomena for tangent-to-identity germs.
status_evidence.claim: Formal normal form work exists but does not close the purely degenerate case.
